detail.description:
This reach of river, the Nizina Canyon, is a segment on a longer river trip.

You have a couple options for what you run before you reach the start of this section. Most people
drive to McCarthy and put-in on the [Kennicott River](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/
3163/) and run about 5 miles down to the confluence with the Nizina.
Alternatively, you can charter a plane to take you up to the Nizina Glacier and do the 35 miles on the
[Upper Nizina](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/3164/) to the start of the
run described here.

Once you reach the confluence with the [Chitina](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/
9/), you'll be continuing on downstream on that river to the town or Chitina located at
the confluence of the Copper. From there you can either take-out or keep on going down the [Copper](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/2972/).
